title: content.switches.flipped (v1)
description: A person flipped content switches — GitHub Actions repository variables of one outlet — from the studio (content/switches/README.md). Published by the worker that wrote them, after reading each back: who, which outlet, the scope, the reason, and each variable's old and new value and whether it held. Every write attempted is recorded, whether or not it held. The hub's switch map (bamr87/bamr87 _data/fleet.yml) is not changed: it records the flip separately.

scope.description: One switch, or every switch of the outlet.

switch.description: The variable a one-switch flip named; null for an outlet.

by.description: The username of the person who confirmed it.

loops.description: The hub map's loops the variable gates; empty when the map has none.

old.description: The value before; null when it was unset.

verified.description: Read back with the new value.
